mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(statistics_order.id) AS total_order_count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN statistics_order.status = 'PICKED_UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS completed_order_count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN statistics_order.status IN ('CANCELED', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS canceled_order_count, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(statistics_payment.amount), 0) FROM payments AS statistics_payment WHERE statistics_payment.status = 'DONE' AND statistics_payment.approved_at >= #{start} AND statistics_payment.approved_at < #{end} ) AS total_sales_amount FROM orders AS statistics_order WHERE statistics_order.created_at >= #{start} AND statistics_order.created_at < #{end}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT statistics_payment.id FROM payments AS statistics_payment INNER JOIN orders AS statistics_order ON statistics_order.id = statistics_payment.order_id LEFT JOIN order_items AS statistics_item ON statistics_item.order_id = statistics_order.id WHERE statistics_payment.status = 'DONE' AND statistics_payment.approved_at >= #{start} AND statistics_payment.approved_at < #{end} GROUP BY statistics_payment.id, statistics_payment.amount, statistics_order.original_amount HAVING statistics_order.original_amount <> COALESCE(SUM(statistics_item.total_amount), 0) OR ( statistics_payment.amount > 0 AND statistics_order.original_amount = 0 ) ) AS invalid_product_sales_order )
SELECT DATE(MIN(statistics_order.created_at)) FROM orders AS statistics_order
SELECT DATE(MIN(statistics_payment.approved_at)) FROM payments AS statistics_payment WHERE statistics_payment.approved_at IS NOT NULL
